bio.text: Darryl Rouson represents District 16 in the Florida Senate, to which Rouson was elected in 2016 and reelected subsequently.
Rouson served in the Florida House of Representatives from 2008 to 2016, was a Pinellas County prosecutor, and was a member of the Tax and Budget Reform Commission from 2007 to 2008.
Rouson is an attorney with a B.A. from Xavier of New Orleans (1977) and a J.D. from the University of Florida (1980). Rouson was born in New Orleans and moved to Florida in 1959.
